facts.fact: UNESCO's readiness assessment profile notes an absence of a Freedom of Information law in Mauritius.

MUS.note: Document says no binding AI-specific rules but does not say no rule or authority addresses AI harms.

facts.fact: UNESCO's readiness assessment profile says Mauritius lacks binding AI-specific regulations and guidelines for AI procurement, accountability and ethical use.
UNESCO says Mauritius's National AI Strategy 2018 exists, though it judges it outdated.
UNESCO says the 2018 National AI Strategy led to the setup of the Mauritius Emerging Technologies Council (METC), the leading institution for AI awareness and development.

MUS.note: Document gives about 10 data centres by about 5 operators but does not say they rent to others or give a Tier or cloud region.
Only says data protection frameworks are strong; no law, standing or application stated.

facts.fact: The document cites the ITU as reporting 80% of Mauritius's population using the internet, last documented in 2023.

MUS.note: No ownership, for-hire status or Tier stated.
Only an average Open Data Inventory score is mentioned, which is a rating.
Only national access (91.6% in 2023) is given, not rural.
No STEM graduate share or research network stated.
